name: dfd
description: Direct-From-Disk streaming sample engine — a resident head + streamed body ring per region, so note-starts, loop wraps and stutter restarts never wait on storage. Portable C++17 core (Source/Allocator injected) with Teensy (SD/PSRAM/AudioStream) and host backends.
keywords: audio, streaming, sampler, teensy, dfd, disk-streaming
